name: Half Plate Armor
summary: Medium armor: AC 15 + Dex modifier (max 2); Disadvantage on Stealth.
text: Medium armor. While you wear it, your base Armor Class is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier, to a maximum of +2. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing it. Putting it on takes 5 minutes and taking it off takes 1 minute. Without training in Medium armor, you have Disadvantage on every D20 Test that uses Strength or Dexterity and you can't cast spells.
